text: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents on time. * 1. Non-criminal record report * 2. Certificate of HSK * 3. High school graduate certificate Graduation certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. The fresh high school graduate shall submit the Certificate of Expected Graduation issued by your high school. Once you get the admission, you should re-submit the High School Graduation Certificate * 4. High school academic transcript Transcript in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. * 5. Recommendation Letters from your two teachers (No fixed format, the recommender shall affix his/her signature). * 6. Foreigner Physical Examination Form * 7. Personal statement: including personal study and work experience, study plan in China and so on. * 8. Passport (Photocopy, an ordinary one that is still valid within three months after enrollment). * 9. Five passport-sized photos(Your name and majorshall be written on the back of the photos). * 10. CSCA Test Transcript(s) -You need to take the official CSCA test organized by the Chinese government and submit the corresponding subject result transcript(s) when applying. Learn more about the CSCA test >> -The test covers Chinese (Humanities and STEM Chinese), Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry. Mathematics is required for all programs, while other subjects depend on the university’s specific requirements. -We are updating detailed information for each university, including the required subjects you have to take for each program and their score requirements. Once the updates are ready, you can check the attachment and information here for this university for the latest information. If no attachment is available yet, it usually means the university has not announced further details. Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.
